Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 听着，孩子。干我们这行，有两个人你最好祈祷永远别碰上——那个叫 Brennan 的，还有他带着的那个《先驱报》记者。
Listen here, kid. In our line of work, there are two people you better pray you never cross paths with -- that Brennan fella, and the Herald reporter he drags around with him...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 两个不折不扣的麻烦精。他们非要把死水搅浑，然后还要转过头来质问你，为什么弄脏了他们的鞋。
Two certified pains in the ass. They insist on stirring up still waters, then turn around and ask you why their shoes got dirty...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 哟，你瞧，刚说到麻烦精，他俩就来了。
Well, would you look at that -- speak of the troublemakers and here they come...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: Brennan，O'Malley。你们倒是来得够快，可惜已经晚了。
Brennan. O'Malley. You got here quickly, but you're already too late.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: Gray小姐那案子我都把文书走完了。手续全齐，印章都盖了。
The Gray woman's case -- I've already filed every last piece of paperwork. Forms signed, stamps pressed...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 小子，把他们轰出去。要是敢反抗，就按妨碍公务上铐。
Son, throw them out. If they resist, cuff them for obstruction.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 我们是来做记录的。Morrison 探长今天说的每一句话我都会写下来。
We're here to make a record. Every word Detective Morrison says tonight, I'm writing it down...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 那个女人手里拿着枪，现场就她一个喘气的。
That woman was holding a gun. She was the only one breathing at the scene...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 她就是凶手。这叫常识，别总想着那些复杂的花样给自己找事。
She's the killer. That's called common sense -- stop looking for complicated angles to make trouble for yourself...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: Vivian 的枪是 .25 ACP——但案发现场的弹壳是 .45 口径。
Vivian's gun is a .25 ACP -- but the shell casing from the crime scene is .45 caliber...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 她的枪根本打不出来。
Her gun can't fire that round. Period.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 这枚弹壳是 .45 ACP。起初是 Rosa 从 Webb 会客室捡到的。
This casing is a .45 ACP. Rosa originally picked it up from Webb's parlor...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 后来……它去了一些不该去的地方。
Then... it went to some places it shouldn't have gone...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 不过现在它回来了。
But now it's back.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: ……小子，把手铐收起来。
...Son, put the handcuffs away.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 然后出去归档。关门。这儿之后就没你的事了。
Then go file the paperwork. Close the door. What happens next is none of your concern.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 操……Brennan！你他妈敢去我家翻东西？！
Shit... Brennan! You went through my goddamn house?!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 只要你能在你的上级面前解释清楚，
As long as you can explain to your superiors...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 案发现场的关键弹壳为什么会跑到你家书房的抽屉里，你现在就可以抓我。
...why a key shell casing from the crime scene ended up in your study drawer at home -- you're welcome to arrest me right now...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 而这枚弹壳来自 James 用过的那把枪。
And this casing came from the gun James once used.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 枪身铭刻：TIDEWATER ARMS。口径：.45 ACP。
The gun is marked TIDEWATER ARMS. Caliber: .45 ACP.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 这才是那晚真正的凶器。
This is the real murder weapon from that night.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: Vivian 的手枪是 .25 ACP。打不出 .45 的弹壳。
Vivian's pistol is a .25 ACP. It can't eject a .45 casing...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 好，弹壳的事——我知道了。
Fine, the casing -- I know about it...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 这现场一团乱，什么时候进了我的箱子，我也不知道。
The scene was a mess -- I don't even know when it ended up in my case...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 进了你的箱子，却没有进你的报告？如果不是我去找，它是不是就永远消失了？
It ended up in your case, but not in your report? If I hadn't gone looking for it, would it have just disappeared forever?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 那只是一次搜查上的失误！
That was just a search error!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 但这改变不了一个事实：我在这一行干了二十年，档案里一张投诉都没有。
But that doesn't change one fact: I've been in this line of work for twenty years, and there isn't a single complaint in my file...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 失误？把真凶的弹壳藏起来，把无辜的人钉死在案子里，这也是失误？
An error? Hiding the real killer's shell casing and pinning an innocent woman to the case -- that's also an error?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: Morrison，你分明就是在故意包庇凶手！
Morrison, you were deliberately shielding the real killer!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 说我包庇凶手——凭什么？我跟那个小厨子有什么关系？我图什么？
Shielding the killer -- on what grounds? What connection do I have with that cook? What's in it for me?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 就凭一枚来路不明的弹壳，加你们脑子里几条线——
Just based on one shell casing from god-knows-where, plus a few threads you've strung together in your heads --

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 就想逼我把盖了章的羁押令撤了重签？
And you think that will make me withdraw and rewrite a stamped detention order?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 没门。
Not a chance.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 我的行为完全符合程序，根本没有任何理由要进行不公正判决！
My actions were entirely by the book -- there is absolutely no grounds for any wrongful verdict!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 没有理由？你欠了一大笔烂赌债，
No grounds? You racked up a massive gambling debt...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 走投无路之下找 “鲸鱼”（Whale） 借了高利贷填窟窿，这就叫理由！
...and when you hit rock bottom, you borrowed from Whale at loan-shark rates to dig yourself out -- that's your grounds!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 借款记录上写得很清楚，贷方是”W 先生”，六千美元。
The loan record is crystal clear -- lender listed as 'Mr. W,' six thousand dollars...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 借款时间刚好是 Webb 案发生的前三周！
The loan date is exactly three weeks before the Webb case!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你用 “鲸鱼”（Whale） 的钱还了赌债，现在欠的就是黑帮的钱。
You used Whale's money to pay off your gambling debt. Now you owed the mob...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 然后 Webb 的案子发生了，你不到一周就把所有线索全压下去了。
Then the Webb case happened, and you buried every lead within a week...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 把无辜的 Vivian 钉死在案子里，这不是什么工作疏漏。
Pinning an innocent Vivian to the case -- that's not some workplace oversight...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你是在用警局的公权力，替黑帮洗清嫌疑，好偿还你的私人债务！
You used your badge and your authority to clear the mob's name -- all to pay off your personal debts!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 一派胡言！就算我和那个什么 “鲸鱼”（Whale） 有点借贷关系……
Utter nonsense! Even if I had some kind of lending arrangement with that... Whale fellow...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 这年头谁身上没点债啊。
Everyone's carrying debt these days...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: “鲸鱼”（Whale）就是个放高利贷的。
Whale is just a loan shark...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 就算我借了他钱，可欠他钱的人多了去了。
Even if I borrowed from him, plenty of people owe him money...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你们不过是在把一桩普通借贷硬扯进案子里。
You're just trying to drag an ordinary loan into this case.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: “鲸鱼”（Whale）只是个放贷的，他跟 Webb 的谋杀根本没有任何关系！
Whale is just a lender. He has absolutely nothing to do with Webb's murder!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 那就看看 Whale 下达过什么指令，又是谁回应了他。
Then look at the order Whale gave—and who answered it.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 这封被撕毁的信纸上，Whale 要某人执行“内部安排”，替他“扫清障碍”。
This torn letter says Whale ordered someone to carry out an 'internal arrangement' and 'remove the obstacle.'

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 收信人的名字虽然被撕掉了，但 James 留下了另一张短笺。
The addressee's name was torn away. But James left another note.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 他约 Whale 今晚八点在蓝月亮后门见。两张字条，把下令的人和回应的人连在了一起。
He told Whale to meet him at the Blue Moon's back door at eight tonight. Together, the two notes link the man who gave the order to the man who answered it.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: “鲸鱼”（Whale） 根本不是什么无关紧要的债主，
Whale is no harmless creditor...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 他就是这起案子的幕后黑手。而你，却在利用手中的职权帮他善后！
He's the mastermind behind this entire case. And you -- you used your authority to clean up after him!

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 就在半小时前，James 已经在酒吧后巷举枪自尽了。
Just half an hour ago, James put a gun to his own head in the alley behind the bar...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 就是因为这封没交出去的信，还有被 “鲸鱼”（Whale） 捏在手里的软肋。
Because of this letter he never delivered -- and the leverage Whale held over him...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 如果你现在还打算把这案子按成一桩情杀，
If you still plan to file this case as a crime of passion...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 继续拿 “鲸鱼”（Whale） 的黑钱替他卖命……
...keep taking Whale's dirty money and doing his bidding...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 那 James，就是替你死的。
Then James died for you.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: ……死了？那个爱尔兰厨子。
...Dead? The Irish cook.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 操。六千块钱……就为了六千块赌债，我他妈把自己卷进这种烂事里。
Shit. Six thousand dollars... For six thousand goddamn dollars in gambling debt, I dragged myself into this mess.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你知道“鲸鱼”（Whale）是什么人吗？
Do you have any idea what kind of man Whale is?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你真以为拿着几张纸，就能把艾斯弗德翻过来？
You really think a few pieces of paper can turn Ashford upside down?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 我只知道他买凶杀人，而你在这里帮他擦屁股。
All I know is he paid to have a man killed, and you're here wiping his ass.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 行啊，Brennan。你厉害。
Fine, Brennan. You win...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 既然真凶找到了，还畏罪自杀了……这案子倒是好结了。
Since the real killer's been found and already took himself out... this case should be easy enough to close...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 那个姓 Gray 的女人，我放她走。
The Gray woman -- I'll let her go.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 您最好说到做到，探长。
You'd better keep that promise, Detective.

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 释放令我会签的。但这事没完，Brennan。这摊浑水比你想象的深得多。
I'll sign the release. But this isn't over, Brennan. This mess runs deeper than you think...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你以为你掀翻的是我？
You think it's me you've toppled?

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 你这他妈是自己往 “鲸鱼”（Whale） 的绞肉机里跳。
You're jumping headfirst into Whale's goddamn meat grinder...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 咱们走着瞧，看你能活到哪一天。
Let's see how long you last...

Location: 警察局 / Morrison 办公室
警察局 / Morrison 办公室
Words: 可以，但你得先把Vivian放了，Morrison。
Sure. But you release Vivian first, Morrison.
